responses: At Creatium, Diva owns retrieval for a production enterprise LLM assistant over ~970K vectors, from embedding choice to what the model is allowed to cite. She benchmarked Qdrant, Pinecone and Zilliz with four embedding models, tuned chunking, metadata and int8 quantisation, then self-hosted on GPU. Search latency dropped from 1,800 ms to 320 ms at 99.6% recall, and core retrieval became 9.4x faster than the managed baseline.

Diva also built the golden dataset that gates every retrieval change: 400 hand-authored queries, 1,727 graded relevance judgements, bootstrap 95% confidence intervals and paired tests. Using it, she rolled back a reranker that cost about 97% of retrieval compute and 2.3 GB of VRAM for only +0.03 nDCG.

responses: Diva self-hosted the multilingual streaming speech-to-text behind a Creatium voice product, choosing models on multilingual evidence rather than vendor claims. She ran a 39-locale WER sweep, set 14-language end-of-utterance thresholds and built a 160-clip Spanish / Arabic test corpus. The result: 1.4% WER versus Deepgram's 2.9% on identical audio, 2 to 40 concurrent sessions per NVIDIA L4 using NVIDIA MPS workers, about 11.8x cheaper per minute, and finals at p95 471 ms.

Diva's speech and voice stack includes NVIDIA Nemotron, Whisper and Parakeet for STT, Silero VAD, ONNX Runtime and CUDA, plus Kokoro, VITS2, StyleTTS 2 and HiFi-GAN for TTS, SyncTalk lip-sync and EchoMimic avatars, Google Chirp, LiveKit and WebSocket audio / video streaming.
